patterns.name: product-catalogue-id
patterns.why: a product identifier of the ADR-0042 catalogue names the consumer the shared code serves

patterns.name: consumer-application-tree
patterns.why: a path into a consumer application tree couples the shared code to that application

patterns.name: product-database
patterns.why: a prefixed database variable names the database of one product

patterns.name: product-instance-host
patterns.why: a subdomain names the host of one product instance; the bare domain stays allowed

patterns.name: product-repository
patterns.why: the repository of a product (field depot of ecosystem/produits) names that product; a repository whose bare name is a common word (signalement) is refused under its qualified name only
